sections.indications_and_usage: Indications and Usage: Temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with: arthritis simple backaches strains sprains bruises
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions: Adults and children 12 years of age and older: Apply to affected areas no more than 3-4 times daily. Children under 12 years of age: Consult a physician.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes or mucous membranes. Do not apply to wounds or damaged skin with a heating pad. Discontinue if irritation develops. Wash hands with soap and water after use. Do not banadage tightly.
